For a Laman graph with n vertices and generic edge lengths, the number of planar realization classes modulo orientation-preserving rigid motions is at most binomial(2n−4,n−2). The bound comes from twice the degree of the complex projective Cayley–Menger variety, whose degree is one half of that binomial coefficient; it bounds complex solutions and hence real ones. Reflected realizations are counted separately.
scope: Minimally rigid n-vertex planar frameworks with prescribed edge lengths, modulo planar translations and rotations.
